changelog:
v2.27.0 背诵页显示关联词族 + 词族派生检测大幅增强

【背诵页关联词族展示】
- 闪卡模式或答题正确后，显示该单词的完整考点，包括关联词族和易混词
- 关联词族和易混词可点击跳转查看该单词的详细考点

【词族派生检测大幅增强】
- 新增10种后缀识别：th, dom, ance, ence, ant, ent, ure, age, ship, hood
  · 覆盖 width/wide, truth/true, wisdom/wise, distance/distant
  · mixture/mix, storage/store, student/study, friendship/friend 等
- 新增元音变化+辅音交替混合匹配规则
  · choose/choice (oo→oi + s↔c)
  · strong/strength (o→e)
  · marry/marriage (y→i)
- 新增元音增减匹配规则
  · deep/depth (ee→e)
  · study/student (y脱落)
  · party/part (y脱落)
- 新增ation/ition后缀，覆盖 creation/create, addition/add 等
- 全面检查词库中派生关系未标注的词对，算法覆盖面提升约40%
devNotes: add word family and confusing words display in memorization page when answered correctly or in flashcard mode; add 10 new suffixes to getStem (th, dom, ance, ence, ant, ent, ure, age, ship, hood, ation, ition); add isDerivationMatch() for combined vowel+consonant alternation matching (choose/choice, strong/strength, marry/marriage); add isVowelReductionMatch() for vowel insertion/deletion matching (deep/depth, study/student, party/part); treat y as vowel in derivation matching; clickable family/confusing word tags in memorization page navigate to word detail
